description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams' used for filtering employee directory searches within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as employee numbers, name or ID, job title ID, and location ID, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for defining filter parameters for employee directory search, including employee numbers, name or ID, job title, and location.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sort field to 'employee.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers or null.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID string or null.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID or null.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the location ID or null.
